description: Dogfood 2 (Phase 2): the clevis of an elbow joint. A 40 x 30 x 20 block with a 12 mm slot for the forearm link, an 8 mm pivot bore through both ears, and four M4 mounting holes in the base. Faces are addressed with the same selectors the viewport produces when a user clicks them.

args.name: Clevis block
args.intent: Base block of the elbow clevis

args.name: Link slot
args.intent: Slot that receives the forearm link, leaving a 6 mm floor

args.name: Pivot bore
args.intent: 8 mm pivot bore through both ears

args.name: Mounting holes
args.intent: M4 clearance holes to mount the clevis on the upper arm
